statement: Labcorp Holdings Inc.'s cash provided by operating activities increased by $48.3 in FY2025 Q1 compared to the same period in 2024.

CSX Corporation has a long-term locomotive maintenance and rebuild program agreement with a third party that includes commitments for specific locomotive rebuilds and maintenance costs through at least 2035.

CSX Corporation's payments for the long-term maintenance and rebuild program were $311 million in 2024, $236 million in 2023, and $235 million in 2022, with updates to 2023 and 2022 amounts to include locomotive rebuild payments.
Sysco Corporation's operating income increased for the second quarter and first 26 weeks of fiscal 2024 compared to the same periods in fiscal 2023.
Sysco's gross profit dollar and margin percentage improvement in fiscal 2024 was attributed to managing product cost fluctuations through strategic sourcing efforts and disciplined pricing.
Sysco's SYGMA segment sales decreased 1.0% in the second quarter and 1.2% in the first 26 weeks of fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
Sysco's SYGMA segment operating income increased by $9.5 million in the second quarter and $16.6 million in the first 26 weeks of fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.

American Water Works Company, Inc. invested $1.4 billion in the Regulated Businesses during the first six months of 2024, including $1.3 billion for infrastructure improvements and $119 million for acquisitions.
The $119 million acquisition investment in the Regulated Businesses added approximately 33,400 customers, including 26,000 from the Illinois subsidiary's purchase of a wastewater treatment plant.
Paycom Software, Inc.'s capitalized portion of research and development costs increased 26% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Paycom Software, Inc.'s total research and development costs increased 23% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Paycom Software, Inc.'s expensed portion of research and development costs increased 22% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Digital Realty Trust, Inc.'s 2022 awards included 61,661 Class D units and 5,654 Restricted Stock Units that performance vested and qualified for time-based vesting in January 2025.
The 2022 awards' Class D units included 6,997 distribution equivalent units that immediately vested on December 31, 2024.

Microsoft Corporation's Services segment server products revenue decreased 1% in FY2025 Q1 due to lower transactional purchasing ahead of the Windows Server 2025 launch and reduced purchasing of licenses in multi-cloud environments.
Microsoft Corporation's Enterprise and partner services revenue decreased $16 million or 1% in FY2025 Q1.
Microsoft Corporation's Gaming revenue increased $1.7 billion or 43% in FY2025 Q1, driven by growth in Xbox content and services.

Microsoft Corporation's Search and news advertising revenue increased $207 million or 7% in FY2025 Q1, with revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs rising 18% due to higher search volume and revenue per search.
Lockheed Martin Corporation's MFC net sales increased $1.4 billion, or 13%, in FY2024 compared to 2023.

The increase in MFC net sales was primarily due to higher sales of $1.2 billion for tactical and strike missile programs from production ramp up on GMLRS, LRASM, and JASSM, and $145 million for integrated air and missile defense programs from PAC-3 production ramp up.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Renewable Diesel segment margin decreased primarily due to a $599 million unfavorable impact from decreased product prices, primarily renewable diesel.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Renewable Diesel segment experienced a $486 million favorable impact from decreased feedstock costs.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Renewable Diesel segment saw a $55 million favorable impact from a 552,000 gallons per day increase in sales volumes.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Renewable Diesel segment depreciation and amortization expense increased by $14 million, primarily due to higher turnaround and catalyst amortization.

BORGWARNER INC reported no material changes to its risk factors from the prior year's 10-K filing, except for an updated risk factor regarding changes in administrative policy including tariffs and trade agreements.

The updated risk factor highlights potential adverse effects from U.S. tariffs on imports from the European Union, Canada, Mexico, and China, which could increase raw material costs and reduce product demand.

NIKE, Inc. expects gross margins to decline in FY2025 compared to the prior year due to incremental headwinds from factors such as consumer spending caution, product portfolio management, marketplace management, and foreign currency impacts.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp has a 35% interest in a joint venture entity related to a natural gas gathering pipeline project.
The carrying value of EXPAND ENERGY Corp's investment in the joint venture was $307 million as of December 31, 2024, and $238 million as of December 31, 2023.
The joint venture investment includes approximately $17 million of capitalized interest as of December 31, 2024.
Nasdaq, Inc.'s Regulatory Technology business revenue increased 10% in the first quarter of 2025 compared with the same period in 2024.
The increase in Nasdaq, Inc.'s Regulatory Technology revenue was driven by AR growth of 11% and five new clients.
Nasdaq, Inc.'s Regulatory Technology AR increased from $328 million in 2024 to $362 million in 2025.
Verisk Analytics, Inc. earns revenues through agreements for hosted subscriptions, advisory/consulting services, and transactional solutions, recurring and non-recurring.
For the six months ended June 30, 2024, approximately 81% of Verisk Analytics, Inc.'s insurance revenues were derived from hosted subscriptions through agreements (generally one to five years).
Verisk Analytics, Inc.'s personnel expenses represented approximately 58% of its total operating expenses (excluding gains/losses related to dispositions) for the six months ended June 30, 2024.
Tyson Foods, Inc.'s Beef segment sales increased $312 million in the three months ended December 28, 2024, compared to the three months ended December 30, 2023.
The Beef segment sales volume increase was driven by higher average carcass weights and increased head harvested.
Tyson Foods, Inc.'s Beef segment operating income improved by $142 million in the three months ended December 28, 2024, compared to the three months ended December 30, 2023.
CSX Corporation's total revenue increased 1% in the third quarter 2024 compared to the third quarter 2023.
The revenue increase was primarily due to higher merchandise and intermodal volumes as well as pricing gains in merchandise.
FPL recorded reserve amortization of approximately $66 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024, and $637 million for the six months ended June 30, 2024.
Apple Inc.'s Greater China net sales decreased during the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same quarter in 2024 due to lower net sales of iPhone.
The decrease in Greater China net sales was partially offset by a favorable year-over-year impact from the strength in the renminbi relative to the U.S. dollar during the first quarter of 2025.
Automatic Data Processing, Inc. recorded a pre-tax (loss)/benefit of approximately $(1.7) million for the three months ended December 31, 2023, related to ADP Indemnity.
The change in ADP Indemnity's (loss)/benefit was primarily due to changes in estimated actuarial losses.
ADP Indemnity entered into a reinsurance arrangement with Chubb Limited in July 2023 to cover losses for the fiscal 2024 policy year.
Insulet Corporation's total revenue increased 23.3% in FY2024 Q2 compared with the same period in FY2023.
The revenue increase was primarily driven by higher volume from a growing customer base and a higher average selling price, particularly in the pharmacy channel.
U.S. revenue from Omnipod products increased 27.3% in FY2024 Q2 compared with the same period in FY2023.

Walmart Inc. focuses on increasing comparable sales in the U.S. through its omni-channel business model, including same-store and club sales, eCommerce growth, and expansion of omni-channel initiatives.
Labcorp Holdings Inc. entered into an agreement to acquire a 15% minority interest in SYNLAB for approximately $155.9 (€140.0), anticipated to close in early 2025 subject to regulatory approvals.
The acquisition of SYNLAB will be structured through an intermediate holding company represented on the board with Cinven, Inc. and other investors.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s net income return on average common equity was 22.8% for 2024.

M&T Bank Corporation repurchased 1,190,054 shares of its common stock during FY2024 Q3 at an average cost per share of $166.40, resulting in a total cost of $200 million including the share repurchase excise tax.
PACCAR Inc. is increasing its investment in advanced new trucks and powertrains, enhanced manufacturing capabilities and capacity, and aftermarket distribution capabilities and capacity in 2024.
Abbott Laboratories' Core Laboratory Diagnostics COVID-19 testing-related sales were $8 million in the first nine months of 2024 and $16 million in the first nine months of 2023.
Abbott Laboratories' Molecular Diagnostics COVID-19 testing-related sales were $10 million in the first nine months of 2024 and $36 million in the first nine months of 2023.

Abbott Laboratories' CGM systems sales totaled $4.7 billion in the first nine months of 2024, reflecting a 21.4 percent increase from $3.9 billion in the first nine months of 2023, excluding foreign exchange effects.
Oracle Corporation's non-operating income, net increased by $69 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2025 compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2024.
The increase in non-operating income was primarily due to a $32 million decrease in foreign currency losses and a $49 million decrease in losses from equity investments.
The increase in non-operating income was partially offset by higher expenses for noncontrolling interests in income.
Domino's Pizza, Inc. generates revenues and earnings through supply chain operations primarily in the U.S. and Canada and by operating Company-owned stores in the U.S.
Domino's international markets involve granting geographical rights to master franchisees who may sub-franchise and operate stores.
Domino's financial results are primarily driven by retail sales at franchised and Company-owned stores.

Lam Research Corporation expects it to be more difficult to sell its products to a given customer for a product line application if that customer initially selects a competitor’s equipment for the same product line application.
Nucor Corporation increased its regular quarterly cash dividend to $0.55 per share in December 2024.
Nucor paid aggregate dividends of $2.16 per share in 2024, compared with $2.04 per share in 2023.

Delta Air Lines, Inc.'s Latin America region revenue increased during FY2024 compared to 2023 due to strong demand for leisure destinations in South America and the Caribbean on a 15% increase in capacity.
Delta Air Lines, Inc. expanded its joint venture with LATAM in South America through additional routes, greater network connectivity, and a more streamlined airport experience during FY2024.
PTC Inc.'s PLM software revenue growth for the first nine months of FY'24 (excluding Q1'24 ServiceMax revenue) would have been 6% year-over-year (5% constant currency).
PTC Inc.'s PLM ARR grew 12% (13% constant currency) from Q3’23 to Q3'24.
PTC Inc.'s CAD software revenue decreased in Q3'24 compared to Q3'23, primarily due to lower revenue in the Americas.
PTC Inc.'s CAD ARR grew 8% (10% constant currency) from Q3’23 to Q3'24.
News Corporation's operating expenses decreased $13 million, or 1%, for the three months ended December 31, 2023, compared to the corresponding period of fiscal 2023.

The decrease in operating expenses for the three months ended December 31, 2023 was primarily driven by lower expenses at the Book Publishing segment due to lower manufacturing, freight, and distribution costs, and at the News Media segment due to lower production costs at News UK.

The decrease in operating expenses for the three months ended December 31, 2023 was partially offset by higher expenses at the Subscription Video Services segment due to higher sports programming rights costs.
Foreign currency fluctuations resulted in an operating expense increase of $8 million for the three months ended December 31, 2023.
Phillips 66 expanded its Midstream NGL wellhead-to-market business with the acquisition of Pinnacle Midstream in the third quarter of 2024.
Wynn Resorts, Limited's Casino expenses increased $154.6 million at Wynn Palace and $105.8 million at Wynn Macau for the six months ended June 30, 2024.

The increase in Casino expenses at Wynn Palace and Wynn Macau was primarily due to higher operating costs, including incremental gaming tax expenses of $138.6 million and $95.6 million, respectively, driven by increased casino revenues.
General and administrative expenses increased $11.9 million at Las Vegas Operations and $9.3 million at Corporate and other for the six months ended June 30, 2024.
Northern Trust Corporation's common equity Tier 1 ratio under the standardized approach increased 120 basis points to 12.6% as of June 30, 2024.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc.'s Banking segment revenue increased 2% for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to 2023.

The 2% revenue increase in the Banking segment was driven by a 3% contribution from recurring revenue, primarily due to higher transaction processing revenue, partially offset by a 1% decline in non-recurring revenue from the completion of federally funded pandemic relief programs.

REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. has a contingent reimbursement obligation to Sanofi of approximately $1.635 billion as of December 31, 2024, related to development expenses under the Antibody Collaboration.

Under the Antibody Collaboration with Sanofi, REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. is obligated to reimburse Sanofi for 30% to 50% of worldwide development expenses funded by Sanofi, based on the company's share of collaboration profits.
REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC.'s share of profit from the Antibody Collaboration, net of development balance reimbursement, reached approximately 20% of total antibody net sales for the year.
Teledyne Technologies Incorporated's Marine Instrumentation product line sales increased $20.4 million in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the second quarter of 2023.

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated's Marine Instrumentation product line contributed to a second quarter record in total instrumentation sales despite anticipated declines in other instrumentation product lines.

Global Payments Inc. entered into a definitive agreement to sell its AdvancedMD business for a total purchase price of $1.125 billion, consisting of $1 billion payable at closing and up to $125 million contingent on specified returns.
Essex Property Trust, Inc. notes that U.S. stockholders may deduct 20% of ordinary dividends from a REIT for taxable years beginning before January 1, 2026.
The 20% deduction for REIT dividends may result in a higher effective tax rate compared to regular corporate qualified dividends.
The AES Corporation completed the construction of 643 megawatts of energy storage and solar projects and signed or was awarded 443 megawatts of new long-term PPAs in FY2025 Q1.
Expedia Group's lodging segment accounted for 77% of total worldwide revenue in the first quarter of 2025.
Room nights booked in Expedia Group's lodging segment grew 6% in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.

3M Company's credit ratings include an A3 rating from Moody's Investors Service with a stable outlook, a BBB+ rating from S&P Global Ratings with a negative outlook, and an A- rating from Fitch with a stable outlook as of the filing period.
3M's credit ratings are important to its cost of capital, as they influence borrowing costs and access to lenders.
3M's credit ratings could be impacted by future leverage additions, potentially affecting borrowing costs and liquidity.
CarMax, Inc.'s adjusted debt to capital ratio, net of cash on hand, was below the targeted range for the third quarter of fiscal 2024.
The adjusted debt to capital ratio calculation excludes non-recourse notes payable, finance lease liabilities, a multiple of eight times rent expense, and includes total shareholders’ equity.
